taiwan_aviation.headline: 史瓦帝尼政府A340專機由桃園轉場高雄　轉場目的尚待官方說明
taiwan_aviation.summary: 公開航跡顯示，史瓦帝尼王國政府一架Airbus A340-313X專機於今（14）日中午自桃園國際機場（TPE）起飛，轉場前往高雄國際機場（KHH）。航班追蹤資料列出該機於臺北時間下午12時05分起飛，原預計下午1時24分抵達高雄。目前尚未取得官方對此次轉場目的的說明，無法僅憑航跡確認是否涉及航機保養或其他安排。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: Eswatini Government A340 Repositions From Taoyuan to Kaohsiung; Purpose Awaiting Official Confirmation
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: Public flight tracking shows an Eswatini government Airbus A340-313X departing Taiwan Taoyuan International Airport (TPE) around midday today, October 14, to reposition to Kaohsiung International Airport (KHH). Tracking data recorded departure at 12:05 Taipei time and initially estimated arrival in Kaohsiung at 13:24. No official explanation of the purpose of this repositioning has been obtained, and the flight path alone cannot establish whether it involves aircraft maintenance or other arrangements.

Flight-tracking records identify the aircraft as HB-JDH and show that it continued to Zurich later that day.

international_aviation.headline_en: MARSS signs Kuwait contract for nationwide counter-drone defense system
international_aviation.summary_en: AeroTime reported that MARSS signed a £370 million ($489 million) contract with Kuwait to provide a nationwide counter-drone defense system that includes hard-kill interceptors. On October 12, 2026, MARSS said the system would cover threats from the air and the sea. Electro-optical, radar and sonar sensors installed across a network of sites will feed central command centers.
